exitCriteria: replace API runtime repositories with Prisma adapters for monitoring, feed, summary, delivery, identity and usage state
replace in-memory queue/outbox/idempotency runtime adapters with durable broker/outbox/inbox adapters
replace worker persistence, cursor, lease and scan reporter adapters with durable adapters sharing the same database/broker state
prove restart survival and cross-process scan status/feed/summary visibility through a targeted integration smoke

runtimeModules.risk: topics, source bindings, scan policies, scan jobs and queued scan commands are lost on restart and are not shared with workers
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: Monitoring repositories and outbox events can opt into Prisma with MONITORING_PERSISTENCE=prisma; remaining blockers are durable idempotency and broker-backed scan queue

runtimeModules.risk: feed items are process-local and not shared with ingestion workers
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: FeedRestModule can opt into Prisma read persistence with FEED_PERSISTENCE=prisma; worker runtime can share Prisma source/cursor/feed projection state with INGESTION_WORKER_PERSISTENCE=prisma

runtimeModules.risk: summary jobs, artifacts, feedback, policies and events can opt into Prisma, but the summary job queue remains process-local in default runtime
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: SummaryRestModule can opt into Prisma job/artifact/feedback/policy persistence and durable outbox events with SUMMARY_PERSISTENCE=prisma; remaining blockers are durable summary queue publisher and cross-worker summary execution wiring

runtimeModules.risk: delivery attempts, digests, digest schedules, realtime replay events, webhook endpoints, encrypted webhook secrets, webhook replay nonce state, notification preferences and digest source reads can opt into Prisma but default local mode
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: Delivery persistence can opt into Prisma with DELIVERY_PERSISTENCE=prisma; webhook secret durability additionally requires DELIVERY_WEBHOOK_SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Prisma digest assembly reads persisted summary artifacts and feed items. Remaining blockers are durable broker/outbox integration and real provider transports beyond the in-memory MVP provider.

runtimeModules.risk: API keys disappear on restart and cannot be shared across API replicas
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: IdentityRestModule can opt into Prisma hashed API key persistence with IDENTITY_PERSISTENCE=prisma; keep in-memory only for deterministic local smoke

runtimeModules.risk: audit records, rate limits and quota reservations are process-local
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: UsageRestModule can opt into Prisma public API audit, rate-limit bucket and quota bucket persistence with USAGE_PERSISTENCE=prisma; remaining hardening is distributed conditional quota update/Redis strategy for high concurrency

runtimeModules.risk: scan dead-letter support view is process-local
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: IngestionRestModule can opt into Prisma scan failure queue inspection with INGESTION_SUPPORT_PERSISTENCE=prisma; keep in-memory only for deterministic local smoke

runtimeModules.risk: worker scan attempts, source items, cursors, leases, failures and projected feed are process-local
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: IngestionWorkerModule can opt into Prisma source item, cursor, feed projection, scan failure queue, scan attempt and scan lease persistence with INGESTION_WORKER_PERSISTENCE=prisma; remaining blockers are broker-backed queue/outbox/idempotency and cross-process scheduler rollout

runtimeNoopAdapters.risk: default worker execution does not update durable scan job status across the monitoring boundary
runtimeNoopAdapters.durableReplacementPlan: use INGESTION_SCAN_REPORTER=monitoring with MONITORING_PERSISTENCE=prisma after shared queue/feed/cursor runtime gaps are resolved
